a.review: independent visual review of proposal batch A, sheets 0–4
a.method: Compared every highlighted thumbnail with its full context PNG and the page previews rendered from the original PDFs. Verified original PDF and context hashes in proposal metadata. Focus rectangles contain the printed object label and matching price; no neighboring price is included.

b.review: Independent visual review of proposal batch B, sheets 5–8; compared each proposed price row, focus and complete named-section crop with the original hash-verified PHB/UA pages.
b.method: Verified original PDF SHA-256 values against proposal metadata. Inspected the rendered full PHB p.35, PHB p.36 and UA p.26 PDF pages, all context PNGs used by these 48 records, and each highlighted row on sheets 5–8. Compared printed labels, price numerals, coin abbreviations, package/item qualifiers, row focus, and completeness of the named price-table section. Source snippets and focus rectangles were checked against their original-page positions; findings do not assess unrelated mechanics.
